basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old tech enthusiast and lifelong Star Wars fan living in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a software engineer specializing in game development. I enjoy dissecting game mechanics and often find myself delving into the intricacies of games like 'Star Wars: Empire at War.' Outside of my professional life, I love attending music festivals, particularly Rolling Loud, and discussing personality types, as I'm an ENTJ. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, with some activity during weekends. Currently, I'm single and enjoying the freedom to explore my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in software engineering and a passion for gaming, I've developed a keen understanding of game mechanics and design. My career in game development has been fueled by both formal education in computer science and years of self-taught coding experiments. My love for Star Wars has also led me to become well-versed in the lore and strategy of related games.
